content.description: Pallet Exchange is the definitive NFT marketplace built natively for the Sei Network, designed for professional digital asset trading. Optimized for Sei's "Twin-Turbo" consensus, the platform offers sub-second finality and near-zero transaction costs. Pallet serves as the primary liquidity hub for major Sei collections like Seiyans and Colony, providing a seamless and responsive user experience. Featuring advanced tools like real-time floor tracking and instant sweep functionality, Pallet Exchange is a cornerstone of the Sei creator economy for both retail and pro traders.
